name: FindMeadow — Cross-post to social media
description: Write once, choose your social accounts, and publish or schedule with Meadow. Share text, images, videos, and carousels from Chrome.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src https://findmeadow.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://findmeadow.com; media-src 'self' blob: https://findmeadow.com; frame-src 'none'
